prompt: A town of 2000 people grows $10\%$ per year. How many people after 2 years?
hint: Up 10% means multiply by 1.10 each year — do NOT just add 200 twice.

hints.text: Up 10% means multiply by 1.10 each year — do NOT just add 200 twice.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: One year first: $10\%$ of $2000$ is $200$, so year one ends at $2200$. Now take $10\%$ of the NEW total, not the old one.

explanation: That is 2420 people — more than $2000 + 200 + 200 = 2400$, because year 2 grows the NEW total.

alternativeExplanations.title: Year-by-year table
steps: Year 2 adds 10% of 2200 = 220 → 2420. The add-on grows each year.

alternativeExplanations.title: Interest on the interest
steps: But the 200 newcomers from year 1 also grow 10% in year 2 — that extra 10% of 200 is 20 more, so 2400 + 20 = 2420.
